/*insertCaApprovalKepMgpDtEaiItemInfo*/ INSERT INTO ICOMTRXL (DOC_NAME ,TARGET ,KEY_1 ,KEY_2 ,KEY_3 ,KEY_4 ,KEY_5 ,KEY_6 ,KEY_7 ,KEY_8 ,KEY_9 ,KEY_10) SELECT 'SEC_ITEM', A.PO_NO, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'CHANGE_PRICE', A.PM_NO, A.PM_SEQ, ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ' FROM KEPMGPDT A WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND A.PM_NO =#{PM_NO} AND A.PM_SEQ = #{PM_SEQ} AND A.RE_UNIT_PRICE != A.CH_UNIT_PRICE

/*setSyopProxbuyCatalogChangeKEPCURRENCYDT*/ MERGE INTO KEP_CURRENCY_DT A USING (SELECT (SELECT A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY A WHERE A.COM_CODE=#{BELOW_COMORG_CODE}) AS BUYER, BUYER_ITEM_NO, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ, REG_USER_ID, CH_UNIT_PRICE FROM KEPMGPDT WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND PM_NO = #{PM_NO} AND PM_SEQ = #{PM_SEQ} AND STATUS != 'D') B ON ( A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.CONTRACT_NO = B.CONTRACT_NO AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = B.CONTRACT_SEQ AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE = F_GET_EXCHANGE_RATE(#{BELOW_COMORG_CODE}, B.CH_UNIT_PRICE, A.EXP_CODE, '01') , A.EXP_KR_UNIT_PRICE = F_GET_EXCHANGE_RATE(#{BELOW_COMORG_CODE}, B.CH_UNIT_PRICE, A.EXP_CODE, '03') , A.EXP_INC_EXPENSE = F_GET_EXCHANGE_RATE(#{BELOW_COMORG_CODE}, B.CH_UNIT_PRICE, A.EXP_CODE, '02') , A.CHANGE_USER_ID = B.REG_USER_ID , A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , A.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS')

/*setSyopProxbuyCatalogChangeKEPCURRENCYDT_HIST*/ INSERT INTO KEP_CURRENCY_HIST ( EXP_CODE ,BUYER ,BUYER_ITEM_NO ,CONTRACT_NO ,CONTRACT_SEQ ,EXP_SEQ ,STATUS ,EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE ,EXP_KR_UNIT_PRICE ,EXP_INC_EXPENSE ,ADD_USER_ID ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ) SELECT B.EXP_CODE , (SELECT A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY A WHERE A.COM_CODE=#{BELOW_COMORG_CODE}) , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , A.CONTRACT_NO , A.CONTRACT_SEQ ,NVL((SELECT TO_NUMBER(MAX(E.EXP_SEQ)) FROM KEP_CURRENCY_HIST E WHERE E.EXP_CODE = B.EXP_CODE AND E.BUYER = A.PO_NO AND E.CONTRACT_NO = A.CONTRACT_NO AND E.CONTRACT_SEQ = A.CONTRACT_SEQ),0) +1 , 'C' , F_GET_EXCHANGE_RATE(#{BELOW_COMORG_CODE},A.CH_UNIT_PRICE,B.EXP_CODE,'01') , F_GET_EXCHANGE_RATE(#{BELOW_COMORG_CODE},A.CH_UNIT_PRICE,B.EXP_CODE,'03') , F_GET_EXCHANGE_RATE(#{BELOW_COMORG_CODE},A.CH_UNIT_PRICE,B.EXP_CODE,'02') , A.REG_USER_ID , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') , A.REG_USER_ID , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') FROM KEPMGPDT A, KEP_CURRENCY_DT B WHERE A.PO_NO = B.BUYER AND A.CONTRACT_NO = B.CONTRACT_NO AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = B.CONTRACT_SEQ AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND A.PM_NO = #{PM_NO} AND A.PM_SEQ = #{PM_SEQ} AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND B.STATUS != 'D'
